shortDescription: Manages domain-permissions-profile objects on Checkpoint over Web Services API

options.name: access_control
options.description:
Access Control permissions.
Only a 'Customized' permission-type profile can edit these permissions.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: color
options.description: Color of the object. Should be one of existing colors.

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments string.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: edit_common_objects
options.description:
Define and manage objects in the Check Point database, Network Objects, Services, Custom Application Site, VPN Community, Users, Servers, Resources, Time, UserCheck, and Limit.
Only a 'Customized' permission-type profile can edit this permission.

options.name: endpoint
options.description:
Endpoint permissions. Not supported for Multi-Domain Servers.
Only a 'Customized' permission-type profile can edit these permissions.

options.name: events_and_reports
options.description:
Events and Reports permissions.
Only a 'Customized' permission-type profile can edit these permissions.

options.name: gateways
options.description:
Gateways permissions.
Only a 'Customized' permission-type profile can edit these permissions.

options.name: ignore_errors
options.description: Apply changes ignoring errors. You won't be able to publish such a changes. If ignore-warnings flag was omitted - warnings will also be ignored.

options.name: ignore_warnings
options.description: Apply changes ignoring warnings.

options.name: management
options.description: Management permissions.

options.name: monitoring_and_logging
options.description:
Monitoring and Logging permissions.
'Customized' permission-type profile can edit all these permissions. "Read Write All" permission-type can edit only dlp-logs-including-confidential-fields and manage-dlp-messages permissions.

options.name: name
options.description: Object name.

options.name: others
options.description:
Additional permissions.
Only a 'Customized' permission-type profile can edit these permissions.

options.name: permission_type
options.description: The type of the Permissions Profile.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the access rule (present or absent).

options.name: tags
options.description: Collection of tag identifiers.

options.name: threat_prevention
options.description:
Threat Prevention permissions.
Only a 'Customized' permission-type profile can edit these permissions.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
